steps.text: Glug. Glug.
I watch the bubbles in the water cooler. They rise up in an unending stream, and then they pop.
Many people are walking out of the dour hall, taking advantage of the arbiter calling a recess to stretch their legs, and voice their opinions on the matter while they are at it.

In my moment of distraction, the water overflows, spilling onto the floor. The noblewoman behind me languidly moves away from the puddle, afraid the 'pure snowmelt from Sami' would damage her worn leather boots.
Bozhe moy, I once had the exact same pair...

spans.text: , I once had the exact same pair...

steps.text: I quickly spin my wheelchair, attempting to flee.

steps.name: Handsome Nobleman
steps.text: Varvara? Is that you?

steps.name: Handsome Nobleman
steps.text: I can hardly believe it. You look...

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: Help me carry these books, they're too heavy!

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: I need to save my strength for tonight's script reading—No, you can't come! This is a student group internal event.

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: ...Are you surprised?

steps.name: Handsome Nobleman
steps.text: No, Varvara. That's not what I mean.

steps.name: Handsome Nobleman
steps.text: We were childhood friends. The bond between nobles is not so easily broken.

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: Do you still think of me as a noble when you see me like this?

steps.name: Handsome Nobleman
steps.text: What do you—

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: Did you not hear what Zoya and that other girl said?

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: Why would that Arbiter twist everything we have endured?

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: Ha, haha. Looking at my trousers?

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: It's fine, look as much as you like. It's not going to bring my shins back.

steps.name: Handsome Nobleman
steps.text: Bozhe moi...

steps.name: Handsome Nobleman
steps.text: Varvara... This is... O, bozhe moi!

steps.name: 'Council of Sixteen' Thug A
steps.text: The votes been tallied yet?

steps.name: 'Council of Sixteen' Thug B
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: 'Council of Sixteen' Thug B
steps.text: The boss decided that, from now on, we're the 'Sixteen Warriors'.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A
steps.text: But why?! I read in an old book that the first sixteen to follow Igor Velikiy got a title that meant 'councilmember', so 'Council' is the only choice!

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B
steps.text: Shut up about your stupid theories... Besides, if we're a 'Council', then we gotta respect a vote, right? Right now everyone thinks 'Warriors' sounds better.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A
steps.text: Blyat. I get less and less happy making this money.

spans.text: . I get less and less happy making this money.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A
steps.text: It's not just the name change. Now we suddenly need to keep track of our results, see who can handle the most kids...

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B
steps.text: Enough whining. Saw you slacking off yesterday, you want the boss to scream his head off at you?

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A
steps.text: Shut up. I sent one of them off last night.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A
steps.text: The one who said he was 'pure Grypherburger stock', Leonid Gelashvili or something.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A
steps.text: I checked some Grypherburg copies of the Almanac of Nobility, didn't see the family there. Then I decided to check some chronicles. Turns out, they're just an ordinary family from the south.

spans.text: I checked some Grypherburg copies of the
, didn't see the family there. Then I decided to check some chronicles. Turns out, they're just an ordinary family from the south.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A
steps.text: The boss only wanted real nobles, so I handled him.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B
steps.text: *sigh* Why bother going to all that trouble? Could've just listened to his accent. Did he sound like a Grypherburger?

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A
steps.text: Accent? I've been shut in this damn place for too long, almost forgot what the locals are supposed to sound like.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A
steps.text: Hey, you, you a Grypherburger?
He gives his seat a pat, and he gets a yelp of fear in return. A student kneels on the ground underneath his buttocks, serving as his chair.

steps.name: Panicked Student
steps.text: I-I-I-I'm a Grypherburger!

steps.name: Panicked Student
steps.text: I've got the accent, I've got family! Please, let me go, gospodin!

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A
steps.text: If I remember right... You're not supposed to speak while you're being a chair. The boss is gonna get real mad at me if he sees this.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A
steps.text: So shut your mouth, alright? If you stay nice and quiet for an hour, I won't see you off today.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B
steps.text: Alright, enough. These kids don't have it easy, what with you terrorizing them all day.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A
steps.text: You, lecturing me?

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A
steps.text: You're the guy who's happy to sit on a stiff corpse.
Upon hearing her comrade's words, the thug pulls her knife out of her 'cushion', warm blood dripping off its blade.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B
steps.text: I like sitting cross-legged, doesn't matter to me if they're dead.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B
steps.text: ...Hey, that little countess there? She's dragging some other girl along with her, think she's a noble too—

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug C
steps.text: Save your strength, dearie. There's nowhere for you to run with all of us here.

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: No, I beg you—

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: I gave Gromov all my money. He said I'm a noble, and that I'll leave here alive.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug C
steps.text: You gave it to him, but not to me. Besides, I don't care about the money.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug C
steps.text: I only care about order, understand? I'll say it clearly, no fighting in the dorm. Who said you could hit that Symposithingy boy?

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: I didn't hit anyone! I just gave him a push—

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug C
steps.text: Excuses! I told you kids a thousand times, fighting is wrong! When will you kids actually listen?

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug C
steps.text: You need to be punished.

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: ...Punished... what?

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug C
steps.text: Hey, Warriors! Beat the life outta this spoiled little princess. I'll think of what to say to Gromov.

steps.name: Everyone
steps.text: You got it!
Varvara closes her eyes tight. A gust of wind sweeps by her cheek, and a few drops of warm liquid splash across her forehead.
She shudders as she opens her eyes. The raised stick is gone, along with its master.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Who's next?!
Zima stands before Varvara, waving about a bloodstained steel pipe as she bellows out her challenge.
There are more footsteps and angry shouts, but they are soon replaced by cries of pain.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey! Don't even think about running!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Aren't you guys the Warriors now? How come even an Originium slug can take more punches than you?

steps.name: 'Pencil Stub'
steps.text: I've got them!

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: We've cut off their escape route too, Sonya! They're not going to get away!
Before long, the nearby Warriors are sprawled out across the ground. Leto pats the dust off her hands, giving one of their heads a good kick before moving back to Sonya's side.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: All taken care of, General.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Great! Time for a break.
Zima crouches down, stretching out a hand to Varvara.
Though Zima's face is still stained with blood, it is the face that has brought her the most relief these past few days.

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: You're... Varvara? There are our people here?

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: Chyort... Just how many Vanguards were captured...?

spans.text: ... Just how many Vanguards were captured...?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Not important. Focus on saving people.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Can you still stand, Varvara?

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: Sonya!

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: *sob*... Sonya, Faddey, I thought I was going to die...

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: Do I remember that you're the daughter of a soldier? Dry your tears.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: It's fine, seriously.

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: Mm... Right.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Listen, we're here to get everyone back.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Is it just you here? Where are the other students being held?

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: They're... They're in the building on the north side.

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: Gromov said the 'VIP Lounge' and 'Common Waiting Area' were there. There's still lots of students trapped in there, but I know the way, at least.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Lead the way.
Varvara tugs on Zima's hand, using her strength to stand. Though she still trembles, the light has returned to her eyes.

It is the light of a drowning girl who has grabbed onto a buoy. Though she does not know what exactly lies behind that door, she believes that as long as Sonya is with her, it is an exit out of this forsaken place.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: We've gotten everyone out, General.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Those thugs were pretty much all bark. Most of the people who were captured are still alive, but... they've been through a lot.

steps.name: 'Pencil Stub'
steps.text: Speaking of the thugs, been a while since we saw them. Almost feels like something's off, haha.

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: Shut up. You're the only one who likes those bastards.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: This building's too close to the exit. It'll be easy to spot us. We can't wait for everyone to calm down before we act.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Pencil Stub, get everyone organized, then lead the way. Rosalind, hold the rear with me.

steps.name: 'Pencil Stub'
steps.text: Got it, General.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hah. You see? Nicknames are easier to work with, da?

spans.text: Hah. You see? Nicknames are easier to work with,

steps.text: The rescued students, several dozen in all, are huddled along the road like canned fins. Some of them had their jackets taken away, their faces streaked with tears.
But with Pencil Stub and his team's coaxing, they slowly stand up and follow their lead, heading towards their camp.

steps.name: Rescued Student A
steps.text: Finally. We're saved.

steps.name: Rescued Student B
steps.text: The sun is out. Let's go, quickly. I'd rather die than go back to that blasted place.

steps.name: Rescued Student B
steps.text: Wait. What's that sound?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Someone's coming. Hide in the buildings, and don't do anything stupid!
Before anyone can react, the Sixteen Warriors appear at the very back of the group, escorting a burly Ursus.
Shrieks break out at the sight of them, and everything immediately devolves into chaos. A few people shout, trying to maintain order, but to no avail.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Stay calm! I'll handle them!

steps.name: Burly Ursus
steps.text: Oh? You must be the Sonya they were talking about.

steps.name: Burly Ursus
steps.text: You're pretty small, aren't you? But you sure can fight.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You Gromov? What're you doing here?

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: Haha. Your fellow students were too hasty, forgot a few important things.

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: Seeing as some people came to the auction, but want to leave without buying a ticket... I've got no choice but to teach them a lesson. Personally.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: There's one part you got wrong. I'm the only one you'll be facing.

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: Just you?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What, scared?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: That weapon you've got looks like a hammer and an axe had a baby. Fearsome.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Didn't think its master would be a spineless coward.

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: ...Pfft. Hahahaha—

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: You're the third one to get a laugh out of me today, little bear. The other two, I already dumped in the snow. They're wishing they had never been born.

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: Come, take a good look at my weapon!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What the—
It is an ebon maw, a voracious abyss.

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: Are they pushing a... cannon?

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: Ready—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Get to cover!

The pitch-black muzzle slowly rises, the grinding of gears piercing the silence. Panic breaks out as people scramble to hide themselves where they can, holding their breath as they wait for the cannon's roar.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: Run! To the buildings by the road!

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: Fire!
For a moment, all sound is driven out of Katorga. All that remains is a keen ringing in the ears.
Zima pokes her head out of a snowbank, her sight blurred by blood. Though she leapt out of the center of the blast, shrapnel has left a gash across her forehead.
Under a layer of dust, a scorched, black pit mars what was once level ground. Flames climb their way up the wooden doors. Around her, there are the bleeding, the injured, the fallen.

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: Wh... Why?! Most of us are noble!

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: Because you pissed me off, you snot-nosed little intellectual.

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: There's only one real rule among the Sixteen Warriors: have your last words ready if you ever make me angry!

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: Ready the second round—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Get everyone out of here, Rosalind! I'll draw their fire! That's an order!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Dammit!

Gromov's laughter can still be heard through the artillery barrage. He does not bother aiming, wantonly raining down fire across the area. Watching pathetic insects scurry about is his greatest joy, after all.
The ramshackle buildings sway. Varvara had been through too much today. She stands by a stone pillar, her eyes blank...

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: Move!

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: AHH!

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: M-My legs, I—

steps.name: Varvara
steps.text: Oh, no no no no NO, I can't feel my legs!

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: ...Save it. You're still alive.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: Faddey! You're bleeding! I need to—

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: ...No. Don't you get it? Just run.

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: Take that Varvara girl with you, and run. All of you. Don't bother about me...

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: I said, RUN!

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: Take care, Faddey...

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: Grab onto my shoulders, Varvara. You're still alive, so just hang on—
As the girls fade into the distance, Faddey lets out a deep breath. The last vestige of his consciousness is beginning to scatter.

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: ...So that's what it feels like... to get something done... to be a hero...

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: The perfect time... for graduation day...

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: Ahh... Feels good to let out all that pent-up frustration that's been building up these past few days.

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: Keep going, don't give them any time to breathe.

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A
steps.text: Alright, I'm on—ARGH!
Gromov leaps aside as a crossbow bolt sprouts out of his lackey's chest. He looks towards its source: a high-rise, from which more bolts are coming.

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: The Unbound? It's that Antosha again!

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: C'mon, keep loading more shells! I'll bury him along with the students!

steps.name: Security Team Captain
steps.text: Gromov! Stop!

steps.name: Security Team Captain
steps.text: Your reckless actions have alarmed Gospodin Pavlovich, and he demands that you cease firing at once. If you dare hurt another noble, he'll have your hide!

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B
steps.text: Hey, Boss... Do we retreat?

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: Retreat? Forgotten how to fight without a cannon, have we?

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: Go catch Antosha! If you don't deal with him, it'll be your hides on the line!

spans.text: Go catch Antosha! If you don't deal with him, it'll be

steps.name: Gromov
steps.text: Now get lost!

steps.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B
steps.text: You got it!
People covered in bandages throng around tonight's bonfires, repeating their experiences today to anyone within earshot, relishing in the joy of the survivor.
Leto still has energy to burn, so she and a few students with medical knowledge run around the camp, making themselves useful.
As for Nika, Yeremey and Pencil Stub, they sit together in silence, fidgeting with the firewood.
Varvara lies in a deep sleep after receiving treatment. She dreams of the parts of her body she has lost forever... as well as her peers, also gone for good.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: The noble girl's alright now. Matvey has brought people to look after her and the other wounded.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Thank you. No amount of thanks could express what we feel. Matvey and the others are professionals when it comes to treating wounds. The Unbound has done so much for us.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Heh. Those non-producing nobles will never understand that workers are far more capable than they are. Even if you start with no skills, as long as you want to survive, Ursus will always 'teach' you.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: That's why I can't understand why you'd waste medicine and energy on these people. They're not worth the effort.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I was the one who took them with me, and I promised them I'd bring everyone back. I saved a few people, but others... They believed in me, but they couldn't come back with us.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Either way, you did all you could. The camp here is much more crowded. You brought back most of them. Mission accomplished.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: But I still have to warn you. Don't expect anything from those spoiled princelings and princesses. There might come a day when you regret saving their sorry hides.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Don't try and deny it, Sonya. You and I both know how few nobles there are who recognize the need to fight for themselves. You should rely on people with more determination.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You're wrong, Antosha.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Look at the faces around the bonfire. Doesn't matter if they're noble or common, there's always someone with their fists clenched tight.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: As long as they haven't given up on resisting, as long as the fire still burns inside them... I won't turn my back on anyone.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I need them. They can become fighters.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: You're delusional.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: There's only ever a small subsection of the people who are actually decisive. You should pick a team of smart, hard-working, ordinary students, and come with me.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Once we get rid of the two in charge, we'll be out of here quick.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Thanks, Antosha, but I've already made my decision.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: When the crisis hits, no one can stay out of it. I will turn them into a real unit. No one gets left behind.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Doesn't matter if it's Gromov, Pavlovich, or those assholes pushing the cannon while they look down on us—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: We'll knock them all to the ground!

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Today's operation might've given you prestige, but it's also given you blind faith.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: I don't understand how those soft-handed weaklings who can't even hold a weapon tight are meant to take down those madmen, and that cannon.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: As long as they can walk and make a fist, they can do it. I'll start by teaching them how to march.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Past experience tells me that, with the right tactics, even a weakling can be worth ten men.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: As for the cannon, all we can do is wait for the right opportunity. We can't take it head-on, for now at least.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Maybe... My friends can bring us some opportunities.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Your friends? The ones outside Katorga?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: How can you be so sure they're working on helping you?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I've got absolutely zero doubt they are.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You can't imagine the things we've been through together.
